intent_record.intent_summary: Consolidated error handling cleanup paths to eliminate code duplication and ensure consistent device resource management
intent_record.what: Refactored error handling paths to consolidate device cleanup into a single 'bad_put_device' label, removed duplicate dm_put_device() calls from multiple error branches, and added error message string to ti->error on handler name allocation failure
intent_record.how: Ensures consistent device cleanup across all error paths by routing them through a common cleanup label, reduces code duplication in error handling, and improves error reporting by setting descriptive error messages

grouping_result.intent: Consolidated error handling cleanup paths to eliminate code duplication and ensure consistent device resource management

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement allocates memory for attached_handler_name via scsi_dh_attached_handler_name(). Based on the vulnerability description, improper error handling or memory management during handler initialization could lead to use-after-free or double-free vulnerabilities when attached_handler_name is freed after being passed to setup_scsi_dh(). The allocation at line 952 is the source of the memory that requires proper cleanup on error paths, making this the vulnerable statement.
